source: NZS 3101:2006 Amendment 3 and AS/NZS 4671 (500E bars HD10-HD40); the other values the Australian pack's

sources.barDiameters: AS/NZS 4671 Grade 500E deformed bars 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40 mm (the sizes rolled for New Zealand; SAEngine's sets by use)
sources.barNames: New Zealand practice HD (high-strength deformed, 500E) and the diameter; D for 300E (not offered)
sources.shearStress: NZS 3101:2006 9.3.9.3.4: vc = kd ka kn vb, vb = (0.07 + 10 ρw) √f'c within 0.08 √f'c and 0.2 √f'c; kd = ka = kn = 1 taken (aggregate at least 20 mm, at least the minimum shear reinforcement, no axial force: SAEngine practice)
sources.columnRho: NZS 3101:2006 10.3.8.1: Ast at least 0.8 Ag / fy (0.0016 at 500 MPa: SAEngine keeps 0.008 as the practical least) and at most 0.08 Ag (ductile columns 18/fy in 10.4.6.2: not checked)
sources.slabStrainMin: NZS 3101 has no εt limit of slabs: the parent's ACI-type 0.004 (SAEngine practice)
sources.shrinkage: NZS 3101:2006 8.8.1: shrinkage and temperature steel 0.7 Ag/fy, at least 0.0014 Ag (0.0023 for 300E below 500 MPa)
sources.walls: NZS 3101:2006 11.3.11.3: walls ρn and ρv at least 0.7/fy (0.0014 for 500E), bars at most min(3 t, 450 mm) apart (11.3.11.4); replaces the Australian pack's AS 3600 11.7 values (to verify)
